items.text: The system shall allow users to navigate from the main AMC site into a dedicated gift card area.
items.annotation_notes: The sequence moves from the main site into a gift card focused section, showing that gift cards are exposed as a navigable site feature rather than a hidden subpage.

claims.claim: The main site exposes gift cards as a navigable area in the global navigation.
The flow reaches a dedicated AMC gift card area after using that navigation path.

items.evidence_note: Step 1 shows Gift Cards in the AMC global navigation. Step 2 shows the dedicated Gift Cards page and gift card menu content.
items.rationale: The visible flow supports both the access mechanism and the resulting gift card area.

items.text: The system shall present a centralized gift card service area that groups major gift card related actions, like purchasing gift cards, checking balances, accessing terms and FAQs, and handling membership or corporate gift card options.
items.annotation_notes: The gift card landing page groups balance checking, purchasing, memberships, and business ordering into one coherent area, which supports a hub style requirement.

claims.claim: The gift card area groups purchasing, balance checking, terms, FAQs, membership gift, and corporate gift card options in one visible service area.
The page also presents gift card purchase, balance check, and business ordering sections as related gift card services.

items.evidence_note: Step 2 shows grouped columns for Buy Gift Cards, A-List Gift Memberships, and Corporate Orders, plus page sections for buying, checking balance, and business orders.
items.rationale: The centralized gift card hub and grouped service categories are directly visible.

items.text: The system shall provide a dedicated workflow for checking gift card balance from the gift card section.

claims.claim: The gift card section provides a visible balance check entry point.
The system opens a dedicated gift-card balance page from the gift-card area.

items.evidence_note: Step 2 shows a Check Balance action. Step 3 shows the Check Gift Card Balance page.
items.rationale: The screenshots show both the balance-check entry point and the dedicated balance-check screen.

items.text: The system shall collect a gift card number and PIN as the core inputs for a balance inquiry.

claims.claim: The balance inquiry form asks for a gift card number.
The balance inquiry form asks for a gift card PIN.

items.evidence_note: Step 3 shows Gift Card Number and Gift Card Pin fields. Step 4 shows the card number filled. Step 5 shows both the card number and PIN filled.
items.rationale: The required input fields are visible and are used during the flow.

items.text: The system shall allow an authenticated user to optionally associate a gift card with their account during the balance check process.

claims.claim: The balance check page is shown while a signed-in account context is visible.
The form provides an optional control to add the gift card to the user's account.
Selecting the option actually associates the gift card with the user's account.

items.evidence_note: Steps 3 to 5 show HELLO JAMES / My AMC and an unchecked Add gift card to my account checkbox. No completed account-linking outcome is shown.
items.rationale: The visible optional mechanism is supported, but actual account association is not visible.

items.text: The system shall preserve user entered balance check inputs across intermediate form interactions and validation states.
items.annotation_notes: The entered gift card number remains visible when the user proceeds to fill the PIN and when validation feedback appears, indicating form state persistence.
items.manual_verification_notes: the UI seems to be inconsistent. the rules for the red error text below the "Gift Card Number" field  is missing in first field indicating that it is shown after the "Search" button was pressed. the "Search" button however seems to be disabled on this screen (also on every other).  So this is not a realistic flow

claims.claim: The entered gift card number remains reflected after later form interactions.
Entered balance-check inputs remain visible when validation feedback appears.

items.evidence_note: Step 4 shows the number 87654321 entered. Step 5 still shows 87654321 and shows PIN 9753 while inline validation feedback is displayed.
items.rationale: The screenshots visibly preserve the entered values across the validation state.

items.text: The system shall validate gift card lookup inputs and provide inline error feedback when the entered card information does not meet format expectations.
items.annotation_notes: The final screenshot shows a specific inline validation message about minimum card number length, making visible input validation a strong requirement hypothesis.

claims.claim: The form validates entered gift card information against a visible format expectation.
The validation feedback is shown inline near the invalid gift card number field.

items.evidence_note: Step 5 shows the inline message VALUE MUST BE AT LEAST 16 CHARACTERS under the gift card number field.
items.rationale: A format validation error is visibly presented inline.

items.text: The system shall only accept valid gift card actions.
items.annotation_notes: The flow shows validation before any balance result is reached and the search action remains visually subdued, which suggests invalid input should block or discourage submission even though the exact enforcement logic is not fully shown.

claims.claim: The system rejects or flags an invalid gift card number format.
The system only accepts valid gift card actions in all relevant cases.

items.evidence_note: Step 5 shows validation feedback for an invalid card number, but the screenshots cannot verify all valid and invalid action handling.
items.rationale: Visible validation supports part of the requirement, but the universal acceptance rule depends on behavior beyond the shown UI evidence.

items.text: The system shall return the remaining gift card balance after the user provides valid card credentials.

claims.claim: The system provides a balance lookup workflow where card credentials can be entered.
The system accepts valid card credentials for balance lookup.
The system returns the remaining gift card balance after valid credentials are provided.

items.evidence_note: Steps 3 to 5 show the lookup form and entered values, but the final visible state is a validation error rather than a balance result.
items.rationale: The visible setup for balance lookup is present, but the successful balance-return outcome is not shown.

items.text: The system shall provide alternative channels for balance inquiries in addition to the self service web form.
items.annotation_notes: The gift card page mentions checking balance through the website, at a theatre, or by phone, indicating the product supports multiple access paths for the same user need.

claims.claim: The gift card page tells users they can check balance through the web form.
The gift-card area presents non-web alternatives for balance inquiries.
The alternative inquiry channels are operational outside the website.

items.evidence_note: Step 2 states that balance can be checked by clicking below, visiting an AMC Theatre, or calling listed phone numbers.
items.rationale: The page visibly provides the alternative channels, but the screenshots cannot verify that those external channels work.

items.text: The system shall support adjacent gift card workflows such as gift card purchase and business ordering from the same gift card service area.
items.annotation_notes: The gift card area visibly includes buy now, bulk gift cards, and package tickets options, showing the balance checker sits within a broader gift card feature set.

claims.claim: The gift card service area provides a gift card purchase workflow entry point.
The same service area provides business ordering workflow entry points.

items.evidence_note: Step 2 shows Buy Now, Buy Gift Cards, Bulk Gift Cards, and Package Tickets options in the gift card area.
items.rationale: Adjacent gift card workflow entry points are visible from the same centralized area.

items.text: The system shall provide clear on page guidance about what information is required to perform a gift card balance lookup.

claims.claim: The balance page clearly states what information is required to perform a balance lookup.
The required balance-lookup information is reinforced by labeled input fields.

items.evidence_note: Step 3 shows the instruction Enter your gift card number and PIN below, plus the two corresponding fields.
items.rationale: The page provides direct task guidance and matching field labels.

items.text: The system shall retain signed in account context while the user navigates gift card related pages.

claims.claim: The signed-in account context is retained on the gift-card service page.
The signed-in account context is retained on gift-card balance pages.

items.evidence_note: Steps 2 to 5 keep HELLO JAMES / My AMC visible in the header.
items.rationale: The account context remains visible across the gift card landing page and balance-check screens.

items.text: The system shall maintain consistent global navigation and branding across gift card related pages.

claims.claim: Global branding is maintained across gift card related content.
Global navigation is maintained across gift card related content.

items.evidence_note: Steps 2 to 5 keep the AMC logo, My AMC context, Showtimes, and main navigation items in the header.
items.rationale: The shown gift-card related pages maintain consistent branding and global navigation.

items.text: The system shall preserve a user's decision to associate a gift card with their account through the remainder of the balance inquiry workflow and reflect that choice when the lookup completes.

claims.claim: A gift card can be marked for association with a user account during balance inquiry.
A selected association decision is preserved through the remainder of the balance inquiry workflow.
The completed lookup reflects the selected account-association decision.

items.evidence_note: The add-to-account option is present, but it is not selected and no completed lookup or reflected association state is shown.
items.rationale: The account-association option is supported, while persistence and completion reflection are not shown.

items.text: The system shall distinguish between input format errors and lookup failures for a well-formed but unrecognized gift card, and present user-facing feedback appropriate to each case.

claims.claim: Input format errors receive user-facing feedback.
Lookup failures for well-formed but unrecognized gift cards receive user-facing feedback.
Well-formed unrecognized card failures are distinguished from other lookup failures.

items.evidence_note: Step 5 shows a format error only. The flow does not show a well-formed but unrecognized card lookup failure.
items.rationale: One feedback class is visible, but the second failure mode and backend distinction are not shown.

items.text: The system shall require a signed-in account before a gift card can be attached to a user profile, while still allowing balance checks to proceed in guest mode.

claims.claim: Gift card attachment is shown in a signed-in account context.
A signed-in account is required before a gift card can be attached to a user profile.
Balance checks can proceed in guest mode.

items.evidence_note: The screenshots show a signed-in user and the add-to-account option, but no guest-mode flow or sign-in enforcement boundary.
items.rationale: The key signed-in versus guest-mode policy distinction cannot be reliably judged from this flow.

items.text: The system shall make all supported gift card balance inquiry paths and help resources discoverable from the centralized gift card service area.

claims.claim: Multiple gift card balance inquiry paths and help resources are discoverable from the centralized service area.
All supported gift card balance inquiry paths are discoverable from the centralized service area.
All relevant help resources for gift card balance inquiries are discoverable from the centralized service area.

items.evidence_note: Step 2 shows balance checking, theatre and phone alternatives, terms, FAQs, and business order help. The universal completeness of all supported paths and all help resources cannot be established from the screenshot flow.
items.rationale: Several paths and resources are visible, but the all-supported-paths and all-help-resources parts remain ambiguous.

items.text: The system shall provide an explicit balance inquiry result state that confirms which gift card was checked and presents the remaining balance separately from the entry form.

claims.claim: The flow provides a balance inquiry entry form.
The flow reaches a separate result state that confirms which gift card was checked.
The flow presents the remaining gift card balance separately from the entry form.

items.evidence_note: The final visible state in step 5 remains the entry form with an inline validation error. No separate result state, checked-card confirmation, or balance value is visible.
items.rationale: The visible flow contradicts the requested result-state outcome by ending on the form with validation feedback instead of a balance result screen.

items.text: The system shall keep the balance lookup action visibly consistent with the current validation state so users can clearly tell when the entered card information is submittable.

claims.claim: The current validation state changes as card information is entered.
The balance lookup action communicates whether the current card information is submittable.

items.evidence_note: Across steps 3, 4, and 5 the Search action appears visually similar while the form moves from blank to partially filled to invalid with an error message.
items.rationale: The visible lookup action does not clearly track or explain whether the current input state is submittable, so the core observable claim is contradicted.
